verdict.rationale: DNSSEC is a fair axis for a domain registrar, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions DNSSEC signing or DS record submission to the registry. The security page lists privacy, account lock, 2FA and Registry Lock, which are adjacent controls and not DNSSEC. The API docs describe general DNS management with no DNSSEC endpoint.

support.subject: As a security engineer, DNSSEC is supported and easy — one-click or API-driven signing with the DS records handled at the registry
